headline.en: Prepare Chinese narration one segment at a time

sub.en: QwenVoice combines a reference-audio record, Chinese sentence segmentation and a single-segment speech command. Its say path uses configured Qwen3-TTS artifacts; long-book and redraw commands are not yet implemented.
sub.zh: QwenVoice 将参考音频记录、中文句子切分和单段语音命令连接起来。say 路径使用配置的 Qwen3-TTS 产物；长篇 book 与 redraw 命令尚未实现。

body.en: The segmenter accumulates whole sentences under a soft character limit.
body.zh: 切分器按软字符上限聚合完整句子。

body.en: VoiceLock hashes reference bytes plus transcript and records model paths.
body.zh: VoiceLock 对参考字节与转录文本计算哈希，并记录模型路径。

body.en: Synthesis returns PCM; rendering converts audio and writes the output file.
body.zh: 合成返回 PCM，渲染阶段转换音频并写入文件。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The complete offline example runs segment_long_text on supplied Chinese text and checks that concatenating these segments reconstructs the input. It generates no audio.
note.zh: 完整离线示例对给定中文文本运行 segment_long_text，并核对该样本的分段拼接可还原输入。不会生成音频。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Actual sentence-boundary segmentation of complete Chinese text, no audio generation or model artifacts.

body.en: The complete offline example runs segment_long_text on supplied Chinese text and checks that concatenating these segments reconstructs the input. It generates no audio.
body.zh: 完整离线示例对给定中文文本运行 segment_long_text，并核对该样本的分段拼接可还原输入。不会生成音频。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/qwenvoice.git
cd qwenvoice
uv venv --python 3.12
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .

limitations.en: book and redraw are placeholders that return exit 64. No complete long-book narration or selective redraw workflow is implemented.
limitations.zh: book 和 redraw 是返回 64 的占位入口，完整长篇配音与局部重绘流程尚未实现。

limitations.en: The soft limit may be exceeded by a single long sentence. The segmenter is punctuation-based; it does not use jieba word boundaries in its current implementation.
limitations.zh: 单个长句可能超过软上限。当前切分器基于标点，并未使用 jieba 词边界。

limitations.en: This demo validates text segmentation only. Native ABI compatibility, voice quality and audio output were not tested.
limitations.zh: 本示例仅验证文本切分，未测试原生 ABI 兼容性、音色质量或音频输出。

body.en: A narration workflow needs to know which text segment, reference recording and model files produced an output. QwenVoice keeps these inputs explicit, while its local segmenter lets you inspect Chinese sentence boundaries before attempting synthesis.
body.zh: 配音流程需要明确每个输出对应的文本片段、参考录音和模型文件。QwenVoice 显式记录这些输入，本地切分器则让你在尝试合成前先检查中文句子边界。

body.en: segment.py provides single- and long-text segmentation helpers. VoiceLock validates reference/model paths and fingerprints the reference content. synth_segment tries the qt3_* FFI interface, then a configured HTTP speech endpoint when the FFI is unavailable. render.py handles the returned PCM and MP3 output.
body.zh: segment.py 提供单段与长文切分函数。VoiceLock 检查参考音频和模型路径，并为参考内容生成指纹。synth_segment 尝试 qt3_* FFI 接口，FFI 不可用时使用配置的 HTTP 语音端点。render.py 处理返回 PCM 和 MP3 输出。

title.en: Text and reference inputs meet at synthesis
title.zh: 文本与参考输入进入合成

body.en: segment.py provides single- and long-text segmentation helpers. VoiceLock validates reference/model paths and fingerprints the reference content. synth_segment tries the qt3_* FFI interface, then a configured HTTP speech endpoint when the FFI is unavailable. render.py handles the returned PCM and MP3 output.
body.zh: segment.py 提供单段与长文切分函数。VoiceLock 检查参考音频和模型路径，并为参考内容生成指纹。synth_segment 尝试 qt3_* FFI 接口，FFI 不可用时使用配置的 HTTP 语音端点。render.py 处理返回 PCM 和 MP3 输出。

alt.en: Text and reference inputs meet at synthesis
alt.zh: 文本与参考输入进入合成

body.en: The Python package does not include model weights or the FFI library. Its reference hash identifies input changes, not a guarantee of speaker similarity or deterministic audio. A speech endpoint must understand the request’s reference-path and transcript fields.
body.zh: Python 包不包含模型权重或 FFI 库。参考哈希用于识别输入变化，不能保证音色相似度或音频确定性。语音端点需理解请求中的参考路径和转录字段。

body.en: The YAML config holds talker_gguf, codec_gguf, ffi_lib_path, http_fallback_url, sample_rate, channels, seed and max_chars_per_segment. Configure the HTTP base with init --http-fallback http://127.0.0.1:8000; say has no --http-fallback option. The implementation appends /v1/audio/speech. Since v0.2.0 only loopback and private (LAN/Docker) addresses are accepted; public endpoints are refused so the reference material never leaves the machine.
body.zh: YAML 配置包含 talker_gguf、codec_gguf、ffi_lib_path、http_fallback_url、sample_rate、channels、seed 和 max_chars_per_segment。HTTP 基础地址通过 init --http-fallback http://127.0.0.1:8000 配置；say 没有 --http-fallback 参数。实现会追加 /v1/audio/speech，自 v0.2.0 起仅接受回环与私有（局域网/容器）地址，公网端点会被拒绝，参考资料永不离开本机。

body.en: Replace artifact and recording paths with real compatible files before running the audio commands. init reports availability and writes ~/.qwenvoice/config.yml; it can write configuration even when artifacts are missing. say locks inputs and synthesizes one segment. Use a voice sample you are authorized to synthesize from.
body.zh: 运行音频命令前，应将产物和录音路径替换为真实兼容文件。init 报告可用性并写入 ~/.qwenvoice/config.yml；即使产物缺失也可能写配置。say 锁定输入并合成单段。请使用有权用于合成的参考音频。

details.code:
.venv/bin/qwenvoice init --talker ./models/talker.gguf --codec ./models/codec.gguf --ffi-lib ./libgoqwen3ttscpp.dylib
.venv/bin/qwenvoice say --voice ./reference.wav --ref-text "参考录音的准确转录" --text "你好，欢迎收听。" --out ./hello.mp3
